channel.title: Press releases from QuantumColleagues
channel.description: Press releases and media information from QuantumColleagues™. Businesses buy AI colleagues from us, Admin Core first, and the revenue funds free post-AI training for every generation.

item.title: QuantumColleagues awarded 10,000 GPU hours on Isambard-AI to find the best AI models for UK social care
item.description: The Northamptonshire AI company will use the UK’s national AI supercomputer, through the AI Research Resource (AIRR) programme, to test which open models suit care work and how to run them on providers’ own hardware.

item.title: Career & Beyond reaches 1,200 users in its first week, the free careers tool that takes no data
item.description: QuantumColleagues’ free careers app took no money and no personal data from the people who used it, and around 1,200 of them used it in week one.

item.title: QuantumColleagues launches Career & Beyond, a free career change tool for every generation
item.description: The UK AI-for-good company releases its first free give back: a web app that maps working life as a tree, starting from the skills people already have. No sign up, no cost, on any phone.

item.title: New UK AI company is built to give back, funding post-AI training for every generation
item.description: Businesses buy AI from QuantumColleagues™, and the revenue funds post-AI training for the people most at risk of being left behind by it, young people starting out, and people in later life. Giving back isn’t a side project; it’s the reason the company exists. Its first product, Proust, is available now.
